# Madeline Hou

> Full-stack product engineer in Sacramento, CA. I turn messy operational work into clear specs and software people rely on.

Open to product engineering roles.

This site is a personal homepage: a 3D egg tart you can spin, my name, and links. The details below are the useful part for anyone looking me up.

## About

- Full-stack engineer with about 4.5 years of experience, most recently at Gemini Legal (2022 to 2026), building legal workflow automation and modernizing legacy systems.
- I work across product and engineering: I figure out how a system really works, including the code, the users, and the rules, before changing it.
- I moved into engineering from economics and operations (B.A. Economics, UC Riverside).
- Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and AWS.
